predict_reading_order: predict reading order of page elements sorted by page, headers, main content, and footers
predict_to_captions: predict caption associations for tables, pictures, and code blocks in sorted page elements
predict_to_footnotes: predict footnote associations for tables and pictures in sorted page elements
predict_merges: predict text element merges based on hyphenation patterns across consecutive elements
create_page_element: create a PageElement with bounding box coordinates, label, text, and page metadata
